# Pixelcraft (v0.1.0)

> Portable, open-source Agent Skills pack (MIT) for distinctive, evidence-verified UI and rigorous UX across web, native mobile, desktop, TUI, data apps, email, documents, spatial, and game interfaces.

- Canonical showcase: https://thanhnguyxnorg.github.io/Pixelcraft/
- Repository: https://github.com/ThanhNguyxnOrg/Pixelcraft
- Package: `@thanhnguyxn/pixelcraft`
- Install (all skills): `npx skills add ThanhNguyxnOrg/Pixelcraft` or `npm i -g @thanhnguyxn/pixelcraft && pixelcraft add all --agent <host>`
- Supported coding agents (14): claude, codex, agents, devin, cursor, gemini, copilot, windsurf, opencode, kiro, cline, roo, droid, antigravity
- Verification metrics: 26 skills, 247 framework references, 9 zero-dependency Node QA scripts, 19 DTCG token export targets, 66 offline eval fixtures, 22 multi-stack proof exhibits.

## Core Loop & Authority Order
1. Explicit user brief outranks everything.
2. Existing project tokens, conventions, and locks outrank Pixelcraft taste.
3. Platform conventions, legal duties, and the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility floor outrank stylistic ambition.
4. Pixelcraft workflow: Plan & Grill-Me -> Frame -> Brainstorm & Diverge -> Specify -> Build -> Verify & Critique -> Report (with `rendered`, `static`, `model-judgment`, `not-checked`, or `waived` evidence labels).

## Skills (26)
- **pixelcraft** (Core): Orchestrates distinctive, evidence-verified UI work across any frontend stack.
- **pixelcraft-plan** (Core): Plans greenfield and brownfield UI work, runs Socratic Grill-Me discovery interviews for ambiguous or greenfield briefs, selects platforms and technology stacks while rejecting lazy defaults, maps complex capabilities to purpose-built libraries, checks dependency freshness and lockfile reproducibility, records architecture decisions (ADR), and produces the .pixelcraft/plan.md consumed by later Pixelcraft skills.
- **pixelcraft-direction** (Core): Generates distinctive visual direction without template collapse.
- **pixelcraft-craft** (System): Applies high-craft visual design decisions across platforms.
- **pixelcraft-tokens** (System): Creates, resolves, and exports cross-platform design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) 2025.10 format and DTCG Resolver specification. [Scripts: export-tokens.mjs]
- **pixelcraft-ux** (System): Designs rigorous user experience before and during implementation across any frontend stack.
- **pixelcraft-patterns** (System): Applies surface-independent product UX patterns without collapsing into generic templates.
- **pixelcraft-dataviz** (System): Designs and verifies truthful, legible, accessible data visualization across any stack.
- **pixelcraft-accessibility** (System): Applies and verifies the accessibility floor across platforms.
- **pixelcraft-brandkit** (System): Creates premium brand-kit and identity-board image generation briefs for brand kits, logo systems, brand guidelines, moodboards, identity decks, visual-world presentations, launch identities, logo concepts, palette/type systems, and implementation-ready brand direction.
- **pixelcraft-web** (Platforms): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into idiomatic web UI across HTML/CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, SvelteKit, SolidStart, Angular, Astro, Qwik, Preact, Fresh, Hono, htmx, Alpine, Lit, Rails/Hotwire, Laravel/Livewire/Filament/Inertia, Symfony UX, WordPress, Django/FastAPI/FastHTML, Phoenix LiveView, Blazor, Go templ/Gomponents, Rust Leptos/Dioxus, Kotlin, Java, Dart Jaspr, Elm, ClojureScript, F#, and Scala.
- **pixelcraft-mobile** (Platforms): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into idiomatic mobile UI across SwiftUI (incl.
- **pixelcraft-data-apps** (Platforms): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into data applications, AI/ML demos, dashboards, notebooks, BI reports, and internal tools in any language.
- **pixelcraft-desktop** (Platforms): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into desktop applications across Tauri, Electron, Electrobun, Qt 6/PySide6/PyQt6/QML, WinUI 3/WPF, AppKit, SwiftUI macOS, GTK4/libadwaita, Avalonia, Rust GUI (GPUI, Dioxus, Iced, libcosmic, Vizia, Slint, egui, AccessKit), JavaFX/Swing, C++/C/Zig GUI (JUCE, GTKmm, FLTK, wxWidgets, Dear ImGui, Nuklear, Ultralight), Go GUI (Wails v3, Fyne, Gio), and Uno Platform.
- **pixelcraft-tui** (Platforms): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into terminal user interfaces across Textual, Rich, Ink, Bubble Tea v2/Lip Gloss, Ratatui, Terminal.Gui, Spectre.Console, prompt_toolkit, OpenTUI, FTXUI, and Clack/CLI prompts.
- **pixelcraft-extensions** (Platforms): Designs and verifies host-constrained extension and plugin interfaces.
- **pixelcraft-game-ui** (Platforms): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into game interfaces across Unity UI Toolkit, Unity uGUI/TextMeshPro, Godot Control/UI (GDScript/C#), Unreal UMG/CommonUI/MVVM, Bevy, LÖVE2D, MonoGame, Phaser/PixiJS/Kaplay, Ebitengine, Macroquad, Flame, Pygame/Arcade, NoesisGUI/RmlUi/Gameface/Dear ImGui, and Raylib/SDL3/Defold/Cocos.
- **pixelcraft-spatial** (Platforms): Designs and verifies embodied spatial, XR, VR, and AR interfaces across visionOS 26, Android XR (Jetpack XR / Compose for XR), Meta Horizon OS / Meta Spatial SDK, WebXR (@react-three/xr, Wonderland Engine, Needle Engine), Unity XR Interaction Toolkit, and Unreal OpenXR.
- **pixelcraft-constrained** (Platforms): Designs and verifies interfaces for constrained or nonstandard surfaces: TV/console/10-foot UI (Roku/BrightScript, Fire TV/Vega OS, tvOS, Compose for TV, webOS/Tizen), D-pad spatial focus, watchOS/Compose for Wear OS, e-ink displays, POS/ISA-101 HMI/kiosks, embedded MCU UI (LVGL, Slint MCU, TouchGFX, Qt for MCUs, embedded-graphics), automotive CarPlay/Android Auto/AAOS, and Realtime Voice AI/WebRTC voice agents/Siri App Intents/Alexa+.
- **pixelcraft-email** (Channels): Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into email that survives real clients.
- **pixelcraft-document** (Channels): Designs and verifies paginated documents, print output, reports, invoices, CVs, Office exports, and slide decks across web and document tooling.
- **pixelcraft-media** (Channels): Designs and verifies social cards, Open Graph/Twitter images, YouTube thumbnails, repository banners, SVG posters, video frames, and motion graphics for external platforms.
- **pixelcraft-chat-ui** (Channels): Designs and verifies conversational interfaces across two tracks—(A) host-constrained messaging platforms and mini apps (Slack Block Kit/AI Assistants, Discord Components V2/Activities, Telegram Bots/Mini Apps, Zalo Mini Apps/ZNS, WhatsApp Interactive Messages/Flows, Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards/AI Library, LINE LIFF/Flex Messages, WeChat Mini Program) and (B) app-owned AI and agentic chat workspaces (Vercel AI SDK UI, assistant-ui, CopilotKit v2, AG-UI, MCP Apps/MCP-UI, OpenAI Apps SDK, Google A2UI, LangGraph useStream, streaming traces, branching, split artifacts, and approval gates).
- **pixelcraft-review** (Verify): Audits, critiques, and polishes UI with evidence-backed findings. [Scripts: slop-scan.mjs]
- **pixelcraft-visual-qa** (Verify): Verifies interfaces through rendered evidence using a render → screenshot → self-critique → fix loop and finish gate. [Scripts: check-contrast.mjs, check-email.mjs, check-pdf.mjs, check-tui.mjs, finish-gate.mjs, shoot.mjs, style-inventory.mjs]
- **pixelcraft-handoff** (Verify): Translates approved designs, Figma MCP context, Code Connect bindings, Dev Mode specs, Penpot files, screenshots, mockups, and motion handoff prototypes into faithful implementation without losing existing architecture.
